_comment: Mock assessment responses matching Reference §11 API shape exactly. One per persona in personas.json.

persona_low.recommendation_text: Your symptoms appear mild and self-limiting. Rest, stay hydrated, and monitor. Consult a doctor if symptoms worsen or persist beyond 5–7 days.
persona_low._disclaimer: This is an AI-generated possible-conditions read, not a medical diagnosis. A doctor makes the final call.

persona_moderate.recommendation_text: Consult a physician within 24 hours. Seek urgent care immediately if you develop difficulty breathing, chest pain, severe headache, or confusion.
persona_moderate._disclaimer: This is an AI-generated possible-conditions read, not a medical diagnosis. A doctor makes the final call.

persona_high.recommendation_text: Your symptoms require urgent medical evaluation — seek care today, do not wait. If chest tightness worsens, breathing becomes severely difficult, or you experience arm/jaw pain, call emergency services immediately.
persona_high._disclaimer: This is an AI-generated possible-conditions read, not a medical diagnosis. A doctor makes the final call.

emergency_triggers.description: Vitals indicate a potential life-threatening emergency (low SpO₂, low blood pressure, high heart rate).

persona_emergency_vitals.recommendation_text: Seek immediate emergency medical care. Call emergency services or go to the nearest emergency room NOW. Do not wait for a chat response.
persona_emergency_vitals._disclaimer: Emergency guidance — this assessment was made by a rule-based safety system, not AI. Call emergency services immediately.

emergency_triggers.description: Your description includes symptoms that require immediate emergency care (severe chest pain, difficulty breathing).
